name: Michael W. Stulken
prior_offices: Weston County attorney (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Michael W. Stulken is the Weston County attorney and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Official July 29, 2026, commissioners minutes record him present as county attorney. The News Letter Journal reported that he was unopposed in the August 2026 Republican primary.
